shapeSummary: Flat rectangular plate, 160 mm (X) by 60 mm (Z) by 2 mm thick (Y, from 0 to 2). It has a centered 31 x 11 grid of 3 mm through holes at 5 mm pitch (341 holes), leaving a 5 mm margin on all sides. Angle brackets, shaft mounts, screws, nuts, sprue pegs and tabs are not modeled.
warnings: The 160 x 60 mm outline comes from unverified vendor data.
The 2 mm plate thickness is a placeholder. It is neither stated nor visible in the image.
The grid is assumed to be centered on the plate with a 5 mm edge margin.
Angle brackets, shaft mounts, hardware and the molding sprue pegs and tabs are omitted.
Y is treated as the up axis per the rules, so the thickness runs along Y rather than Z as in the image analysis.
cadquery:
t = 2.0
plate = cq.Workplane('XY').box(160, t, 60, centered=(True, False, True))
holes = cq.Workplane('XZ').rarray(5, 5, 31, 11).circle(1.5).extrude(-t)
part = plate.cut(holes)
